title: Not what I was hoping for
text: Not what I was hoping for. I have daily headaches, and bought this pillow based on some of the reviews that it could help with neck pain.  I really wasn't impressed.  I didn't feel it offered any better support than any other pillow I've tried, and it was a big pain getting it into a pillow case since it weighed a ton after being filled.
